🇵🇱 Poland gifts Trump an amber throne Polish President Karol Nawrocki presented Donald Trump with a richly decorated amber chair during his visit to Washington. The gift, intended for the US leader's 80th birthday, was made by Polish craftsman Lucjan Myrta. The transfer was not publicised; neither the Polish Foreign Ministry nor the embassy in Washington were informed, and details within the presidential chancellery were restricted to a small circle. The order was originally placed during Trump's first term but remained undelivered until now. Marcin Przydacz, head of the Bureau of International Policy, stated that the item impressed the American president. The cost of the chair remains undisclosed.
